item.title: MLB notes: New Red Sox pitching directors looking to keep pipeline flowing
item.description: Over the past two years the Red Sox pitching program has been completely transformed, and now the club is handing the baton to two new directors whose job will be to ensure the pitching pipeline keeps flowing.

item.title: Alex Karaban cements himself among UConn legends with most important stat
item.description: The list of all-time great college basketball players from UConn feels endless. But Massachusetts native Alex Karaban found a way to outdo them all.

item.title: Knicks’ Mikal Bridges erupts for 25 points in win vs. Spurs: ‘He’s incredible’
item.description: Mikal Bridges won’t talk much about himself. At least not on offense. But a game like Sunday's was long overdue.

item.title: Knicks rout Spurs, 114-89, in performance worthy of NBA title contention
item.description: They looked like a team that could win it all. At least the version of the Knicks that walked into the Garden on Sunday did.
